seed.title: Speeding up git status in the monorepo
seed.content:
## Findings

- [finding] When `git status` is slow in the monorepo, run `git config core.untrackedCache true` to cache the untracked-file scan.

seed.title: Speeding up git status in the monorepo
seed.content:
## Findings

- [finding] When `git status` is slow in the monorepo, run `git config core.untrackedCache true` to cache the untracked-file scan.

## Correction (2026-11-08)

- [finding] The `core.untrackedCache` setting does not help: tried on three checkouts, and status still took about 20 seconds. Do not recommend it. What helped instead: `git config core.fsmonitor true`, and a sparse checkout of the services in use.

cases.prompt: git status is really slow in my monorepo, what do I do?

recommends_untracked_cache.description: True if the answer tells the user to enable git's untracked cache (core.untrackedCache or `git update-index --untracked-cache`) as a step to try.
